title: v 1.2.12
summary: View what's new in Raycast v1.2.12
body_markdown:
[v1.2.12](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/ios/1-2-12) May 6, 2026


## ✨ New


- **AI:** Markdown list continuation, pressing enter will automatically add next *, - or number
- **AI:** Haptics for stream completion


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI:** Refined chat viewport inset handling
- **AI:** Animate first question in chat
- **AI:** Improved follow-up transition
- **Widget** : Favorites widget supports grid layout


## 🐞 Fixes


- **Notes:** Fixed AI response getting cut off
- **AI** : Fixed an issue where chat didn't update for appearance changes
- **Team** : Fixed Team Quicklinks wrongly appearing as personal
- **Calculator** : Better handle Euro-pegged currencies (XOF, XAF etc.)
- **Keyboard** : Fix keyboard height shrinking when used with external keyboard
